artifacts.synopsis: TEs Bulkeley and Gillikin complained that Highlands Presbytery refused to record their dissent against Presbytery's act of recording a letter from the Arden Presbyterian Session affirming the Martins' Christian character. The SJC denied the complaint but went further, annulling Presbytery's recording of the Session…

artifacts.title: Session of Harvestwood PCA v. New River Presbytery (Complaint)
artifacts.synopsis: The SJC sustained the complaint of the Session of Harvestwood Presbyterian Church against New River Presbytery, holding that Presbytery erred in ruling on the acceptability of a Sunday school teacher without having the matter properly referred for final disposition or through appeal/complaint channels, and without an adequate record of what the teacher actually believed regarding theological matters such as theistic evolution and the historicity of Adam.

artifacts.title: General Assembly power to give directions to SJC on judicial decisions

matches.evidence: The CCB found an overture allowing the Assembly to direct SJC judicial reasoning was in conflict with the Constitution, because a commission concludes business as the court itself under BCO 15.

artifacts.title: General Assembly authority to review and vote on SJC judicial decisions

matches.evidence: The CCB found an overture allowing the Assembly to vote on SJC decisions was in conflict with the Constitution and also assigned tasks beyond the CCB's own purview under RAO 8.2.b.
